batches.name: Bloomfield, Windsor, Windsor Locks, Simsbury, Granby, Canton, Suffield
batches.why: Mostly single-church parishes plus St. Damien of Molokai (Windsor) and Mary, Gate of Heaven (Windsor Locks), two-church parishes the directory groups. GCatholic still lists St. Gertrude (Windsor), St. Bernard (Tariffville) and St. Joseph (Suffield), which the directory does not; St. Joseph, Poquonock is the directory's St. Damien: St. Joseph Church. St. Therese, Granby's old domain now redirects to stpgranby.org: check what it covers.

batches.name: West Hartford, Farmington, Avon, Newington, Wethersfield
batches.why: Two-church parishes (St. Gianna, St. Thomas and St. Timothy, Our Lady of Knock, Annunciation, Christ the King). Incarnation's and Christ the King's old sites both redirect to wethersfieldcatholic.org. The Sacred Heart of Jesus Korean quasi-parish (Wethersfield) is probably GCatholic's Sacred Heart, Wethersfield; check whether it has its own bulletin. GCatholic's St. Helena, West Hartford is not in the directory.

batches.name: Hartford
batches.why: City with many closures: GCatholic still lists Sacred Heart, St. Anne-Immaculate Conception, St. Lawrence O'Toole, St. Luke, St. Peter and separate St. Justin and St. Michael, none in the directory. Settle where each went from current bulletins. Holy Trinity Mission and the Shrine of Maria Reina de la Paz may print in another parish's bulletin; Our Lady of Fatima's only listed site is a Facebook group. Nine parishes, mostly single-church.

batches.name: Enfield, East Windsor, South Windsor, Manchester, Marlborough
batches.why: Large merged parishes: St. Jeanne Jugan (four Enfield churches; GCatholic adds St. Adalbert), St. Teresa of Calcutta (four Manchester churches), St. Marianne Cope, St. Junipero Serra (whose ParishesOnline org is still named for St. Margaret Mary). Check every church still has Mass.

batches.name: East Hartford, Glastonbury, Rocky Hill
batches.why: North American Martyrs and the St. Isaac Jogues Ghanaian quasi-parish share namct.org and one ParishesOnline org: likely one bulletin. St. Rose (decree of relegation 27 Oct 2025) and Our Lady of Peace (relegated to profane use, decree 11 Apr 2026) are closed by decree but GCatholic lists them; Blessed Sacrament is GCatholic-only. GCatholic's St. Isaac Jogues (22063) is the church the quasi-parish uses or a separate building; check. St. John the Baptist, Glastonbury is Ukrainian and in the eastern batch.

batches.name: New Britain, Berlin (Kensington, East Berlin)
batches.why: St. Francis of Assisi (five churches), St. Joachim (St. Ann and St. Mary; St. Mary's link smnb.org redirects to stjoachimct.org, which answers 403 to probes: use parish-site-access), Holy Cross, Sacred Heart, and St. Paul (Kensington with Sacred Heart, East Berlin). GCatholic adds St. Andrew and St. John the Evangelist. St. Paul's site embeds eCatholic.

batches.name: Bristol, Forestville, Plainville, Southington
batches.why: The clergy list names 'St. Matthew and St. Gregory the Great Parish, Forestville': the directory's St. Matthew (Forestville) and St. Gregory the Great (Bristol) are one parish, probably one bulletin. St. Luke (Southington/Plantsville) lists Immaculate Conception, relegated by decree 27 Oct 2025; check whether Mass continues there. GCatholic adds St. Thomas, Southington.

batches.name: Meriden, Wallingford, Yalesville, Cheshire
batches.why: Our Lady Queen of Angels (three Meriden churches), St. Faustina (St. Stanislaus, Meriden with SS. Peter and Paul, Wallingford), St. Benedict of Nursia (three Wallingford churches incl. Yalesville), St. Rose of Lima, St. Bridget of Sweden (Cheshire; GCatholic still lists Epiphany and St. Thomas Becket separately). GCatholic adds St. Laurent and St. Mary, Meriden. The Legion of Christ college, Cheshire is GCatholic-only. St. Nicholas, Meriden is Ruthenian and in the eastern batch.

batches.name: New Haven and East Haven
batches.why: Blessed Michael McGivney Parish has eight New Haven churches on one ParishesOnline bulletin widget; St. Pio of Pietrelcina spans East Haven (Our Lady of Pompeii, St. Vincent de Paul) and St. Bernadette, New Haven. GCatholic adds St. Brendan, St. Donato, St. John the Baptist, St. Rose of Lima (New Haven) and St. Clare (East Haven), and the Knights of Columbus Museum. St. Mary, New Haven (Dominican priory, McGivney's St. Mary) and its Infant of Prague shrine. Few parishes, many churches.

batches.name: Hamden, North Haven, North Branford, Branford, Guilford, Madison
batches.why: St. Paul VI (four Hamden churches; GCatholic adds St. Ann, St. Joan of Arc, St. Stephen); St. Pier Giorgio Frassati, the merger of St. Ambrose (North Branford/Northford, nbcatholics.org) and St. Elizabeth of the Trinity (North Haven) by decree of 22 Mar 2026, which still had two sites with their own bulletin pages at survey: check whether they now print one. St. John Bosco (Branford; GCatholic adds St. Elizabeth). The Dominican nuns' monastery, North Guilford is GCatholic-only.

batches.name: West Haven, Milford, Orange, Woodbridge
batches.why: St. John XXIII (West Haven; GCatholic adds Our Lady of Victory, St. Lawrence, St. Paul), Precious Blood and St. Raphael (Milford, two churches each; GCatholic adds Christ the Redeemer; St. Agnes is in Woodmont), Holy Infant (Orange), Assumption (Woodbridge).

batches.name: Ansonia, Derby, Seymour, Beacon Falls, Oxford
batches.why: Our Lady of the Valley (Ansonia: Assumption and Holy Rosary, both sites now redirect to olvansonia.org) and St. Joseph, Ansonia, which the directory lists as its own parish; GCatholic adds St. Anthony, Ansonia and St. Jude, Derby. Our Lady Queen of the Apostles and St. Michael the Archangel (Derby), St. Nicholas (Seymour, two churches), St. Michael (Beacon Falls), St. Thomas (Oxford). SS. Peter and Paul, Ansonia is Ukrainian and in the eastern batch.

batches.name: Waterbury and Wolcott
batches.why: City full of closures. All Saints (three sites incl. the Shrine of St. Anne), Immaculate Conception (Basilica, Blessed Sacrament, Our Lady of Loreto, St. Michael), Mary, Mother of the Church (St. Leo), Our Lady of Fatima, Our Lady of Mt. Carmel, the St. Patrick Oratory (Institute of Christ the King), and St. Basil the Great, Wolcott. The clergy list names one pastor for Mary, Mother of the Church and St. Basil, and their ParishesOnline org is named 'st-basil-the-great-mary-mother-of-the-church-st-leo': likely one bulletin. GCatholic adds St. Joseph, St. Lucy, St. Margaret, SS. Peter and Paul, St. Stanislaus Kostka, Sacred Heart (Iglesia Sagrado Corazon) and Wolcott's St. Maria Goretti and St. Pius X.

batches.name: Naugatuck, Prospect, Middlebury, Southbury, Watertown
batches.why: St. Francis of Assisi and St. Vincent Ferrer, Naugatuck share a pastor (clergy list); check for one bulletin. GCatholic adds St. Hedwig and St. Mary, Union City (Naugatuck). St. Carlo Acutis (Middlebury and Southbury; renamed by decree effective 29 Aug 2026, site now carloacutisct.org), Holy Disciples (Watertown and Oakville), St. Anthony (Prospect).

batches.name: Torrington, Winsted, Canaan, Litchfield, New Hartford, Thomaston, Terryville
batches.why: St. Martin of Tours (Canaan, Lakeville, Norfolk; GCatholic adds St. Patrick, Falls Village) and St. Joseph, Winsted share a pastor (clergy list). St. John Paul the Great (Torrington; GCatholic adds Sacred Heart and St. Mary), Our Lady of Hope (New Hartford, Harwinton), St. Louis de Montfort (Litchfield, Bantam, Goshen; GCatholic adds the Lourdes shrine, Litchfield), St. Maximilian Kolbe (Terryville, Thomaston). St. Maron, Torrington and St. Michael, Terryville are Eastern and in the eastern batch.

batches.name: New Milford, Washington Depot, Kent, Sharon, Woodbury, Bethlehem
batches.why: St. Francis Xavier (New Milford, with Our Lady of the Lakes; the directory also has a bare 'St. Francis Xavier Parish' entry with an email address as website) and Our Lady of Perpetual Help, Washington Depot share a pastor (clergy list); GCatholic adds St. Patrick, Roxbury. St. Kateri Tekakwitha (Kent, Sharon; GCatholic adds St. Bridget, Cornwall Bridge). Prince of Peace (Woodbury, Bethlehem). The Abbey of Regina Laudis, Bethlehem is GCatholic-only.

batches.name: Eastern Catholic churches in the territory
batches.why: GCatholic lists eleven Ukrainian, Ruthenian, Maronite and Syro-Malabar churches here. They belong to other jurisdictions (Stamford, Passaic, St. Maron of Brooklyn, St. Thomas of Chicago); confirm each and exclude as other-jurisdiction.
